units.Isaiah 55:7: let the ungodly forsake his ways, and the lawless man his counsels; and let him return to the Lord, and he will receive mercy; for He will abundantly forgive your sins.
units.Isaiah 55:8: For My counsels are not as your counsels, nor are My ways like your ways, says the Lord.
units.Isaiah 55:9: But as the heaven is distant from the earth, so is My way distant from your ways, and your thoughts from My mind.
units.Romans 2:1: Therefore you are without excuse, O man—whoever you are who judges. For when you judge another, you condemn yourself, because you who judge practice the same things.
units.Romans 2:2: And we know that God’s judgment against those who practice such things is according to truth.
units.Romans 2:3: But do you think, O man—you who judge those who practice such things and do them yourself—that you will escape God’s judgment?
units.Romans 2:4: Or do you despise the wealth of His kindness and forbearance and patience, not knowing that God’s kindness leads you to repentance?
units.Romans 2:5: But by your hardness and unrepentant heart, you store up wrath for yourself on the day of wrath and revelation of God’s righteous judgment,
units.Romans 2:6: who will repay each according to his works:
units.Romans 2:7: to those who, through perseverance in good work, seek glory and honor and incorruptibility, eternal life;
units.Romans 2:8: but to those acting from selfish ambition, who disobey the truth but obey unrighteousness, wrath and fury,
units.Romans 2:9: affliction and distress upon every human soul that does evil—the Jew first and also the Greek;
units.Romans 2:10: but glory and honor and peace to everyone who does good, to the Jew first and also to the Greek.
units.Romans 2:11: For there is no partiality with God.
units.Psalms 50:1: For the end. A psalm of David,
units.Psalms 50:2: when Nathan the prophet came to him, when he had gone in to Bathsheba.
units.Psalms 50:3: Have mercy on me, God, according to Thy great mercy, and according to the abundance of Thy compassions blot out my lawless deed.
units.Psalms 50:4: Wash me more and more from my lawlessness, and cleanse me from my sin.
units.Psalms 50:5: For I know my lawlessness, and my sin is continually before me.
units.Psalms 50:6: Against Thee alone I sinned and did evil before Thee, so that Thou mayest be justified in Thy words and prevail when Thou art judged.
units.Psalms 50:7: For behold, I was conceived in lawless deeds, and in sins my mother conceived me.
units.Psalms 50:8: For behold, Thou didst love truth; Thou madest known to me the unseen and hidden things of Thy wisdom.
units.Psalms 50:9: Thou wilt sprinkle me with hyssop, and I will be cleansed; Thou wilt wash me, and I will be whitened beyond snow.
units.Psalms 50:10: Thou wilt make me hear exultation and gladness; humbled bones will exult.
units.Psalms 50:11: Turn Thy face away from my sins, and blot out all my lawless deeds.
units.Psalms 50:12: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew an upright spirit in my inward parts.
units.Psalms 50:13: Do not cast me away from Thy face, and do not remove Thy holy Spirit from me.
units.Psalms 50:14: Restore to me the exultation of Thy salvation, and strengthen me with a governing spirit.
units.Ezekiel 36:22: Therefore say to Israel’s house, ‘Thus says the Lord: I am not acting for you, house of Israel, but because of My holy name, which you profaned among the nations where you entered.
units.Ezekiel 36:23: I will sanctify My great name, profaned among the nations, which you profaned among them. The nations will know that I am the Lord when I am sanctified in you before their eyes.
units.Ezekiel 36:24: I will take you out of the nations, gather you out of all the lands and bring you into your own land.
units.Ezekiel 36:25: I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and you will be cleansed from all your uncleannesses and all your idols. I will cleanse you.
units.Ezekiel 36:26: And I will give you a new heart, and I will give a new spirit within you; and I will take the heart of stone out of your flesh, and give you a heart of flesh.
units.Ezekiel 36:27: I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My ordinances, keep My judgments and do them.
units.Ezekiel 36:28: You will dwell upon the land I gave your fathers. You will be My people, and I will be your God.
units.Ezekiel 36:29: I will save you from all your uncleannesses, summon the grain and multiply it, and will not bring famine upon you.
units.Ezekiel 36:30: I will multiply the tree’s fruit and the field’s produce, so that you do not bear the reproach of famine among the nations.
units.Ezekiel 36:31: You will remember your evil ways and practices that were not good, and feel disgust before them at your lawless deeds and abominations.
units.Ezekiel 36:32: I am not acting because of you, says the Lord, the Lord; this will be known to you. Be ashamed and abashed because of your ways, house of Israel.
units.Wisdom of Solomon 1:12: Do not pursue death through the wandering of your life, nor draw destruction upon yourselves through the works of your hands;
units.Wisdom of Solomon 1:13: For God did not make death, neither does He delight in the destruction of the living.
units.Wisdom of Solomon 1:14: For He created all things that they might exist, and the created things of the world are life-preserving; there is no poison of destruction in them, nor is Hades’ dominion upon the earth.
units.Ezekiel 32:1: In the eleventh year, in the twelfth month, on the first of the month, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 32:2: “Son of man, take up a lament over Pharaoh, Egypt’s king, and say to him, ‘You were likened to a lion of nations, and you are like the dragon in the sea. You butted in your rivers, troubled water with your feet and trampled your rivers.
units.Ezekiel 32:3: Thus says the Lord: I will throw nets of many peoples over you and haul you up with My hook,
units.Ezekiel 32:4: and stretch you out upon the earth; plains will be filled with you. I will seat all the sky’s birds upon you and fill all the beasts of the whole earth with you.
units.Ezekiel 32:5: I will lay your flesh upon the mountains and fill them with your blood,
units.Ezekiel 32:6: and the earth will be watered from your discharges, from your multitude upon the mountains. I will fill ravines with you.
units.Ezekiel 32:7: When you are extinguished, I will cover heaven and darken its stars. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon certainly will not show its light.
units.Ezekiel 32:8: All the things shining light in heaven will grow dark over you, and I will put darkness upon your land, says the Lord, the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 32:9: I will provoke the heart of many peoples when I bring your captivity among the nations, into a land you have not known.
units.Genesis 49:8: “Judah, may your brothers praise you; your hands shall be upon the backs of your enemies, and your father’s sons shall bow down to you.
units.Genesis 49:9: “Judah is a lion’s cub. From a shoot, my son, you have gone up. You reclined and slept as a lion, and as a cub; who shall rouse him?
units.Genesis 49:10: “A ruler shall not fail from Judah, nor a leader from his thighs, until the things reserved for him come; and he shall be the expectation of nations.
units.Genesis 49:11: “Binding his foal to the vine, and his donkey’s colt to the tendril, he shall wash his robe in wine, and his mantle in the blood of the grape.
units.Genesis 49:12: “His eyes are joyful from wine, and his teeth whiter than milk.
units.Proverbs 28:15: One who tyrannizes over a needy nation while himself poor is a hungry lion and a thirsty wolf.
units.Proverbs 28:16: A king lacking revenues is a great extortioner, but one who hates injustice will live a long time.
units.2 Kings 23:30: His servants transported him dead from Mageddo, brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his grave in David’s city. The people of the land took Joachas son of Josiah, anointed him, and made him king in his father’s place.
units.2 Kings 23:31: Joachas was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Amital daughter of Jeremiah, from Lemna.
units.2 Kings 23:32: He did what was evil in the Lord’s eyes, according to everything his fathers had done.
units.2 Kings 23:33: Pharaoh Nechao removed him at Deblatha in Emath’s land so that he would not reign in Jerusalem. He imposed a penalty on the land of one hundred talents of silver and one hundred talents of gold.
units.2 Kings 23:34: Pharaoh Nechao made Eliakim, son of Josiah king of Judah, king over them in place of his father Josiah and changed his name to Joakim. He took Joachas and brought him into Egypt, and he died there.
units.2 Kings 23:35: Joakim gave the silver and gold to Pharaoh, but assessed the land to provide the silver at Pharaoh’s command. Each according to his assessment, they gave the silver and gold with the people of the land, to give to Pharaoh Nechao.
units.Amos 1:1: The words of Amos that came among nakkarim from Tekoa, which he saw concerning Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
units.Amos 1:2: He said: “The Lord spoke from Zion and gave His voice from Jerusalem; the shepherds’ pastures mourned, and Carmel’s summit dried up.”
units.Amos 1:3: The Lord said: “For three impieties of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away from him, because they sawed the pregnant women of those in Gilead with iron saws.
units.Amos 1:4: I will send fire into Hazael’s house, and it will devour the foundations of the son of Ader,
units.Amos 1:5: and I will shatter Damascus’s bars and destroy inhabitants from the Plain of On. I will cut down a tribe from the men of Harran, and the people of Syria, called by name, will be taken captive,” says the Lord.
units.2 Kings 25:27: In the thirty-seventh year of the deportation of Joakim king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh of the month, Euilmarodach king of Babylon, in the year of his reign, lifted the head of Joakim king of Judah and brought him out of his prison house.
units.2 Kings 25:28: He spoke kindly to him and placed his throne above the thrones of the kings who were with him in Babylon,
units.2 Kings 25:29: and he changed his prison garments, and he ate bread continually before him all the days of his life.
units.2 Kings 25:30: His table provision was given to him continually from the king’s house, each day’s portion on its day, all the days of his life.
units.Psalms 1:1: Blessed is the man who did not walk in the counsel of the ungodly, and did not stand in the way of sinners, and did not sit in the seat of pestilent men;
units.Psalms 1:2: but his will is in the Lord’s law, and on His law he will meditate day and night.
units.Psalms 1:3: He will be like the tree planted beside the outlets of waters, which will give its fruit in its season, and whose leaf will not fall off; and everything he does will be prospered.
units.Psalms 1:4: Not so the ungodly, not so, but like chaff which the wind flings away from the face of the earth.
units.Psalms 1:5: Therefore the ungodly will not rise in judgment, nor sinners in the council of the righteous;
units.Psalms 1:6: for the Lord knows the way of the righteous, and the way of the ungodly will perish.
units.Psalms 109:1: Of David. A psalm. The Lord said to my lord: Sit at My right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.
units.Psalms 109:2: The Lord will send out the rod of your power from Zion. Exercise dominion in the midst of your enemies.
units.Psalms 109:3: With you is rule on the day of your power, in the splendors of the holy ones; from the womb, before the morning star, I begot you.
units.Psalms 109:4: The Lord swore and will not change His purpose: You are a priest for ever according to the order of Melchizedek.
units.Psalms 109:5: The Lord at your right hand crushed kings on the day of His anger.
units.Psalms 109:6: He will judge among the nations; He will fill the field with corpses; He will crush heads over the land of many.
units.Psalms 109:7: He will drink from a torrent on the way; therefore he will lift his head.
units.Jeremiah 17:5: Cursed is the person who places his hope in a human and will rest the flesh of his arm upon him, and whose heart departs from the Lord;
units.Jeremiah 17:6: and he will be like a wild tamarisk in the wilderness; he will not see when good things come, and will dwell among salt-plants and in a wilderness, in a salt land that is not inhabited.
units.Jeremiah 17:7: And blessed is the person who has trusted in the Lord, and the Lord will be his hope;
units.Jeremiah 17:8: and he will be like a tree flourishing beside waters, and will send its roots toward moisture, and will not fear when heat comes. Wooded stems will be upon it; in a rainless year it will not fear or cease bearing fruit.
units.Judges 9:7: They told Jotham. He went and stood on Mount Gerizim’s summit, raised his voice, and called out, saying to them, “Listen to me, men of Shechem, and may God listen to you.
units.Judges 9:8: The trees went out to anoint a king for themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’
units.Judges 9:9: The olive tree said to them, ‘Should I leave my richness, which God and human beings have glorified in me, and go rule the trees?’
units.Judges 9:10: The trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come, reign over us.’
units.Judges 9:11: The fig tree said to them, ‘Should I leave my sweetness and my good produce and go rule the trees?’
units.Judges 9:12: The trees said to the vine, ‘Come, reign over us.’
units.Judges 9:13: The vine said to them, ‘Should I leave my wine, human beings’ gladness from God, and go rule the trees?’
units.Judges 9:14: The trees said to the bramble, ‘You come and reign over us.’
units.Judges 9:15: And the bramble said to the trees, ‘If in truth you anoint me king over you, come and trust in my shelter. But if not, let fire come forth from the bramble and consume the cedars of Lebanon.’
units.Judges 9:16: And now, if you dealt in truth and integrity when you made Abimelech king, and if you dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and did to him according to the recompense of his hand—
units.Judges 9:17: for my father fought for you, cast his life into danger, and rescued you from Midian’s hand,
units.Judges 9:18: yet you rose against my father's house today and killed his sons, seventy men upon one stone, and made Abimelech, the son of his slave girl, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother—
units.Judges 9:19: if then you have dealt in truth and integrity with Jerubbaal and his house this day, may you be blessed and rejoice in Abimelech, and may he also rejoice in you.
units.Judges 9:20: But if not, may fire come out from Abimelech and consume Shechem’s men and the house of Maallon; and if not, may fire come out from Shechem’s men and the house of Maallon and consume Abimelech.”
units.Judges 9:21: Jotham ran away, went on the road, and fled to Rara. He dwelt there because of Abimelech his brother.
units.Psalms 79:1: For the end; concerning those who will be changed. A testimony for Asaph; a psalm concerning the Assyrian.
units.Psalms 79:2: Thou who shepherdest Israel, pay attention, Thou who guidest Joseph like sheep; Thou who sittest upon the cherubim, appear.
units.Psalms 79:3: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, rouse Thy dominion, and come to save us.
units.Psalms 79:4: God, turn us back; make Thy face shine, and we shall be saved.
units.Psalms 79:5: Lord, God of powers, how long art Thou angry at the prayer of Thy servant,
units.Psalms 79:6: wilt Thou feed us bread of tears and give us tears to drink by measure?
units.Psalms 79:7: Thou madest us an object of contradiction for our neighbors, and our enemies sneered at us.
units.Psalms 79:8: Lord, God of powers, turn us back; make Thy face shine, and we shall be saved. Diapsalma.

units.1 Samuel 1:24: She went up with him to Shiloh, with a three-year-old calf, loaves, an oiphi of fine flour, and a nebel of wine. She entered the Lord’s house at Shiloh, and the child was with them.
units.1 Samuel 1:25: They brought him before the Lord, and his father slaughtered the sacrifice that he made year by year to the Lord. He brought the child forward and slaughtered the calf. Hannah, the child’s mother, brought him to Eli
units.1 Samuel 1:26: and said, “Please, my lord! As your soul lives, I am the woman who stood before you when praying to the Lord.

units.Ezekiel 14:1: Men from Israel’s elders came to me and sat before me.
units.Ezekiel 14:2: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 14:3: “Son of man, these men have set their thoughts upon their hearts and set the punishment of their injustices before their faces. Shall I indeed answer them?
units.Ezekiel 14:4: Therefore speak to them and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: Anyone of the house of Israel who sets his thoughts upon his heart, places the punishment of his injustice before his face, and comes to the prophet—I, the Lord, will answer him in the things in which his mind is entangled,
units.Ezekiel 14:5: so that it may turn the house of Israel aside in accordance with their hearts, alienated from Me through their reflections.’
units.Ezekiel 14:6: Therefore say to the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Turn back and turn away from your practices and all your impieties, and turn your faces.
units.Ezekiel 14:7: For anyone of the house of Israel or of the sojourners living among Israel who becomes alienated from Me, sets his reflections upon his heart, places the punishment of his injustice before his face, and comes to the prophet to question him concerning Me—I, the Lord, will answer him in that in which he is entangled.
units.Ezekiel 14:8: I will set My face firmly against that person, make him a wilderness and a devastation, and remove him from the midst of My people. You will recognize that I am the Lord.
units.Nehemiah 9:5: The Levites Jesus and Kadmiel said, “Stand up and bless the Lord your God from everlasting to everlasting. They will bless Thy glorious name and exalt it above all blessing and praise.”
units.Nehemiah 9:6: Esdras said, “Thou alone art the Lord. Thou madest heaven, the heaven of heaven and all their array, the earth and everything in it, the seas and everything in them. Thou givest life to all things, and the armies of heaven worship Thee.
units.Nehemiah 9:7: “Thou art the Lord God. Thou didst choose Abram, bring him out of the country of the Chaldeans and give him the name Abraam.
units.Nehemiah 9:8: “Thou didst find his heart faithful before Thee and make a covenant with him to give him the land of the Chananites, Chettites, Amorrites, Pherezites, Jebousites and Gergesites, and to his offspring. Thou didst fulfil Thy words, for Thou art righteous.
units.Nehemiah 9:9: “Thou sawest the humiliation of our fathers in Egypt and heardest their cry at the Red Sea.
units.Nehemiah 9:10: “Thou didst perform signs in Egypt, against Pharao, all his servants and all the people of his land, for Thou knewest that they had acted arrogantly against them. Thou madest a name for Thyself, as it is this day.
units.Nehemiah 9:11: “Thou didst break open the sea before them, and they crossed through the middle of the sea on dry ground. Thou didst hurl their pursuers into the deep like a stone into violent water.
units.Nehemiah 9:12: “Thou didst lead them by a pillar of cloud by day and by a pillar of fire by night, to light for them the way they should travel.
units.Nehemiah 9:13: “Thou camest down upon Mount Sina and spakest to them from heaven. Thou gavest them upright judgments, laws of truth, good ordinances and commandments.
units.Nehemiah 9:14: “Thou madest Thy holy Sabbath known to them and didst command them commandments, ordinances and law through Moses Thy slave.
units.Nehemiah 9:15: “Thou gavest them bread from heaven for their shortage of food and didst bring water from a rock for their thirst. Thou didst tell them to enter and inherit the land that Thou hadst stretched out Thy hand to give them.
units.Nehemiah 9:16: “But they and our fathers acted arrogantly, stiffened their necks and did not listen to Thy commandments.
units.Nehemiah 9:17: “They refused to listen and did not remember Thy wonders that Thou hadst done among them. They stiffened their necks and appointed leadership to return to their slavery in Egypt. But Thou art a merciful and compassionate God, longsuffering and abundant in mercy, and Thou didst not abandon them.
units.Nehemiah 9:18: “Even when they made a cast calf for themselves and said, ‘These are the gods who brought us out of Egypt,’ and committed great provocations,
units.Nehemiah 9:19: “Thou, in Thine abundant compassion, didst not abandon them in the wilderness. Thou didst not turn the pillar of cloud away from them by day, to guide them on the way, or the pillar of fire by night, to light for them the way they should travel.
units.Nehemiah 9:20: “Thou gavest Thy good Spirit to give them understanding. Thou didst not withhold Thy manna from their mouths, and Thou gavest them water for their thirst.
units.Nehemiah 9:21: “For forty years Thou didst nourish them in the wilderness; they lacked nothing. Their garments did not grow old, and their feet did not split open.
units.Nehemiah 9:28: “When they rested, they returned to doing evil before Thee. Thou didst abandon them into the hands of their enemies, who ruled over them. They again cried out to Thee, and Thou didst hear from heaven and rescue them in Thine abundant compassion.
units.Nehemiah 9:29: “Thou didst testify to them to turn them back to Thy law, but they did not listen. Instead, they sinned against Thy commandments and judgments, which, if a person does them, that person will live by them. They presented a disobedient back, stiffened their necks and did not listen.
units.Nehemiah 9:30: “Thou didst prolong Thy dealings with them for many years and testify to them by Thy Spirit through Thy prophets, but they did not give ear. Thou gavest them into the hand of the peoples of the land.
units.Nehemiah 9:31: “In Thine abundant compassion Thou didst not make an end of them or abandon them, for Thou art mighty, merciful and compassionate.
units.Exodus 6:2: God spoke to Moses and said to him, “I am the Lord.
units.Exodus 6:3: I appeared to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob as their God, but I did not reveal My name Lord to them.
units.Exodus 6:4: I established My covenant with them, to give them the land of the Canaanites, the land where they sojourned and lived as foreigners.
units.Exodus 6:5: I have heard the groaning of the sons of Israel, whom the Egyptians enslave, and I have remembered your covenant.
units.Exodus 6:6: Go, say to the sons of Israel: ‘I am the Lord. I will bring you out from the Egyptians’ domination and deliver you from slavery. I will ransom you with an uplifted arm and with great judgment.
units.Exodus 6:7: And I will take you to Myself for a people, and I will be your God; and you shall know that I am the Lord your God, who brought you out from the oppression of the Egyptians.
units.Exodus 6:8: I will bring you into the land concerning which I stretched out My hand to give it to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will give it to you as an inheritance. I am the Lord.’”
units.Exodus 3:7: And the Lord said to Moses, “I have surely seen the affliction of My people in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of their taskmasters; for I know their pain.
units.Exodus 3:8: I have come down to rescue them from the hand of the Egyptians and bring them out of that land into a good and spacious land, a land flowing with milk and honey, to the place of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
units.Exodus 3:9: And now, behold, the cry of the sons of Israel has come to Me; and I have seen the oppression with which the Egyptians oppress them.
units.Exodus 3:10: Come now, and I will send you to Pharaoh king of Egypt; and you shall bring My people, the sons of Israel, out of the land of Egypt.”
units.Psalms 105:6: We sinned with our fathers; we acted lawlessly and unjustly.
units.Psalms 105:7: Our fathers in Egypt did not understand Thy wonders; they did not remember the abundance of Thy mercy and provoked Thee while going up in the Red Sea.
units.Psalms 105:8: He saved them for His name’s sake, to make His might known.
units.Psalms 105:9: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He guided them in the deep as in a wilderness.
units.Psalms 105:10: He saved them from the hand of those hating them and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
units.Psalms 105:11: Water covered those afflicting them; not one of them was left.
units.Psalms 105:12: They believed His words and sang His praise.
units.Psalms 105:13: They hurried and forgot His works; they did not wait for His counsel.
units.Psalms 105:14: They desired a desire in the wilderness and tested God in a waterless place.
units.Psalms 105:15: He gave them their request and sent fullness into their souls.
units.Psalms 105:16: They angered Moses in the camp, and Aaron, the Lord’s holy one.
units.Psalms 105:17: The earth was opened and swallowed Dathan and covered Abiram’s assembly.
units.Psalms 105:18: Fire was kindled in their assembly; a flame burned up sinners.
units.Psalms 105:19: They made a calf at Horeb and bowed down to a carved image.
units.Psalms 105:20: They exchanged their glory for the likeness of a calf that eats grass.
units.Psalms 105:21: They forgot the God who saved them, who did great things in Egypt,
units.Psalms 105:22: wonders in the land of Ham, fearful things at the Red Sea.
units.Psalms 105:23: He said He would destroy them, had not Moses His chosen one stood in the breach before Him, to turn His anger away so He would not destroy.
units.Psalms 105:24: They treated the desirable land as nothing; they did not believe His word.
units.Psalms 105:25: They grumbled in their dwellings; they did not hear the Lord’s voice.
units.Psalms 105:26: He lifted His hand to them, to cast them down in the wilderness,
units.Psalms 105:27: and to cast their offspring down among the nations, and scatter them in the countries.

units.Exodus 13:21: God led them by day in a pillar of cloud to show them the way, and by night in a pillar of fire.

units.Exodus 31:12: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
units.Exodus 31:13: “Command the sons of Israel, saying, ‘See that you keep My Sabbaths, for they are a sign with Me and among you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am the Lord who sanctifies you.
units.Exodus 31:14: You shall keep the Sabbaths, for this is holy to the Lord for you. Whoever profanes it shall surely be put to death. Whoever does work on it, that soul shall be destroyed from among his people.

units.Ezekiel 25:3: and say to Ammon’s sons, ‘Hear the Lord’s word! Thus says the Lord: Because you rejoiced over My holy things when they were profaned, over Israel’s land when it was devastated, and over Judah’s house when they went into captivity,

units.Ezekiel 25:5: I will make Ammon’s city pastures for camels, and Ammon’s sons a pasture for sheep. You will recognize that I am the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 25:6: For thus says the Lord: Because you clapped your hand and made noise with your foot, and rejoiced from your soul over Israel’s land,
units.Ezekiel 25:7: therefore I will stretch My hand against you, give you to plunder among the nations, utterly destroy you from the peoples and make you perish from the countries with destruction. You will recognize that I am the Lord.’
units.Ezekiel 13:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 13:2: “Son of man, prophesy against Israel’s prophets; you will prophesy and say to them, ‘Hear the Lord’s word!
units.Ezekiel 13:3: Thus says the Lord: Woe to those who prophesy from their own heart and see nothing at all!
units.Ezekiel 13:4: Your prophets, Israel, are like foxes in the wildernesses.
units.Ezekiel 13:5: They did not stand in a firm position, and they gathered flocks against the house of Israel. Those saying, ‘On the Lord’s day,’ did not rise.
units.Ezekiel 13:6: They see false things and divine vain things, those who say, ‘The Lord says,’ although the Lord has not sent them; and they began to establish a word.
units.Ezekiel 13:7: Have you not seen a false vision and spoken vain divinations?
units.Ezekiel 13:8: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Because your words are false and your divinations vain, therefore behold, I am against you, says the Lord,
units.Ezekiel 13:9: and I will stretch out My hand against the prophets who see false things and utter vain things. They will not belong to My people’s instruction, nor be written in the register of the house of Israel, nor enter Israel’s land. They will know that I am the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 13:10: Because they misled My people, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there was no peace, and this one builds a wall, and they coat it—if it is going to fall,
units.Ezekiel 13:11: say to those coating it, ‘It will fall.’ There will be a flooding downpour, and I will put stones for hurling into their bonds, and they will fall; there will be an upending wind, and it will be split.
units.Ezekiel 13:12: And behold, the wall has fallen! Will they not say to you, ‘Where is your coating with which you coated it?’
units.Ezekiel 13:13: Therefore thus says the Lord: I will unleash an upending blast with wrath; a flooding downpour will come in My anger, and I will bring the projectile stones in wrath for complete destruction,
units.Ezekiel 13:14: and I will tear down the wall you coated, and it will fall. I will lay it upon the ground; its foundations will be uncovered, and it will fall, and you will be brought to an end with rebukes. You will recognize that I am the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 13:15: I will complete My wrath upon the wall and those coating it, and it will fall. I said to you, ‘There is no wall, nor those coating it—
units.Ezekiel 13:16: the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem and see peace for her, when there is no peace,’ says the Lord.’
units.Isaiah 30:27: Behold, the Lord’s name comes after a long time, wrath burning. His lips’ utterance comes with glory, an utterance full of anger, and the anger of His wrath will consume like fire.
units.Isaiah 30:28: His spirit will come like water sweeping through a ravine, reaching the neck, and will divide to trouble nations in futile wandering. Delusion will pursue them and seize them in their faces.
units.Isaiah 30:29: Must you always rejoice and always enter My holy places like festival-keepers, like people rejoicing as they enter with a flute to the Lord’s mountain, to Israel’s God?
units.Isaiah 30:30: God will make His voice’s glory heard and show His arm’s wrath with fury, anger and consuming flame. He will strike violently with lightning, like water and hail falling together violently.
units.Isaiah 30:31: For at the Lord’s voice the Assyrians will be defeated by the blow with which He strikes them.
units.Isaiah 30:32: It will be all around him, from where he hoped for help, on which he himself relied; they will turn and fight him with flutes and a lyre.
units.Isaiah 30:33: For you will be called to account ahead of time. Has it also been prepared for you to rule a deep ravine, with wood laid out, fire and much wood? The Lord’s wrath is like a ravine burning with sulfur.
units.Ezekiel 21:28: He is to them like one divining a divination before them, and he himself recalls his injustices for remembrance.
units.Ezekiel 21:29: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because you recalled your injustices when your impieties were revealed, so that your sins were seen in all your impieties and practices—because you recalled them, in these you will be captured.
units.Ezekiel 21:30: And you, profane, lawless leader of Israel, whose day has arrived in a season of injustice—an end!—
units.Ezekiel 21:31: thus says the Lord: You removed the tiara and put on the crown. This will not be such. You lowered the high and raised the low.
units.Ezekiel 21:32: Injustice, injustice I will make it! Nor will this be such until the one comes to whom it belongs, and I will hand it over to him.
units.Ezekiel 21:33: And you, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘Thus says the Lord concerning the sons of Ammon and their reproach.’ Say, ‘Sword, sword, drawn for victims and drawn for complete destruction, arise so that you may gleam,
units.Ezekiel 21:34: in your vain vision and your divining false things, to hand you over upon the necks of the wounded lawless, whose day has arrived in a season of injustice—an end!
units.Ezekiel 21:35: Turn back; do not lodge in this place where you were born. In your own land I will judge you
units.Ezekiel 21:36: and pour My anger upon you. I will blow upon you with the fire of My anger and hand you into the hands of barbarian men devising destruction.
units.Ezekiel 21:37: You will be food in fire; your blood will be in the midst of your land. There certainly will be no remembrance of you, for I, the Lord, have spoken.’”
units.Ezekiel 22:6: Behold, the leaders of Israel’s house mingled themselves in you, each with his relatives, in order to shed blood.
units.Ezekiel 22:16: I will take possession in you before the nations’ eyes, and you will know that I am the Lord.’”
units.Hosea 2:4: “Enter into judgment with your mother, enter into judgment! For she is not My wife and I am not her husband. I will remove her prostitution from My face and her adultery from between her breasts,
units.Hosea 2:5: so that I may strip her naked and restore her as on the day of her birth. I will make her like a wilderness, set her like a waterless land and kill her with thirst.
units.Hosea 2:6: I will certainly show no mercy to her children, for they are children of prostitution.
units.Hosea 2:7: For their mother prostituted herself; she who bore them brought shame. She said, ‘I will follow my lovers, who give me my loaves and water, my garments and linen cloths, my oil and everything due to me.’
units.Hosea 2:8: Therefore look, I block her way with thorns and will build up her roads, and she will certainly not find her path.
units.Hosea 2:9: She will pursue her lovers but certainly not catch them; she will seek them but certainly not find them. She will say, ‘I will go and return to my former husband, for it was better for me then than now.’
units.Hosea 2:10: She did not know that it was I who gave her grain, wine and oil and multiplied silver for her; but she made silver and gold objects for Baal.
units.Hosea 2:11: Therefore I will return and recover My grain at its season and My wine at its time; I will take away My garments and linen cloths so that they do not cover her shame.
units.Hosea 2:12: Now I will uncover her uncleanness before her lovers, and certainly no one will deliver her from My hand.
units.Hosea 2:13: I will turn away all her rejoicings, her festivals, new moons and Sabbaths, and all her festal assemblies.
units.Hosea 2:14: I will obliterate her vine and fig trees, of which she said, ‘These are my wages that my lovers gave me.’ I will make them a testimony, and the field’s beasts, heaven’s birds and the earth’s creeping things will devour them.”
units.Hosea 2:15: “I will exact vengeance upon her for the days of the Baalim, when she sacrificed to them, put on her earrings and necklaces and went after her lovers, but forgot Me,” says the Lord.
units.Nahum 1:1: An oracle concerning Nineveh; the book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
units.Nahum 1:2: The Lord is a jealous and avenging God, the Lord avenging with fury, the Lord avenging Himself on His adversaries, and He Himself removes His enemies.
units.Nahum 1:3: The Lord is patient, and His strength is great; the Lord certainly will not acquit. His way is in consummation and shaking; clouds are the dust of His feet.
units.Nahum 1:4: He threatens the sea and dries it up, and makes all the rivers desolate. Bashan and Carmel have dwindled, and Lebanon’s flowering things have failed.
units.Nahum 1:5: Mountains shook before Him and hills were shaken; the whole earth recoiled before Him, and all who dwell in it.
units.Nahum 1:6: Who will stand before His anger? Who will resist His furious wrath? His fury melts rulers, and rocks were crushed before Him.
units.Nahum 3:1: O city of bloodshed, wholly false, full of injustice! Prey will not be touched.
units.Nahum 3:2: The sound of whips and the sound of shaking wheels, of a pursuing horse and a jolting chariot,
units.Nahum 3:3: and of a mounting horseman, a flashing sword and glittering weapons, a multitude of slain and a grievous fall! There was no limit to her nations, and they will weaken in their bodies
units.Nahum 3:4: because of the multitude of prostitution. A prostitute, beautiful and pleasing, mistress of potions, selling nations through her prostitution and tribes through her potions,
units.Nahum 3:5: look, I am against you, says the Lord God Almighty. I will expose your hind parts over your face and show nations your shame and kingdoms your dishonor,
units.Nahum 3:6: and cast abomination upon you according to your impurities, and make you an example,
units.Nahum 3:7: and everyone seeing you will spring away and say, “Miserable Nineveh! Who will lament her? Where shall I seek consolation for her?”
units.Ezekiel 36:16: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 36:17: “Son of man, Israel’s house lived upon their land and defiled it by their way, their idols and their uncleannesses. Their way before Me became like the uncleanness of a woman sitting apart.
units.Ezekiel 36:18: I poured My wrath upon them
units.Ezekiel 36:19: and scattered them among the nations and winnowed them into the countries. I judged them according to their way and their sin.
units.Ezekiel 36:20: They entered the nations where they entered, and profaned My holy name when it was said of them, ‘These are the Lord’s people, and they have left His land.’
units.Ezekiel 36:21: I spared them because of My holy name, which Israel’s house profaned among the nations where they entered.
units.Deuteronomy 28:15: And it shall be, if you do not hearken unto the voice of the Lord your God, to keep and do all His commandments which I command you this day, that all these curses shall come upon you, and overtake you.
units.Deuteronomy 28:23: And the heaven above your head shall be bronze, and the earth beneath you iron.
units.Deuteronomy 28:24: The Lord give dust for the rain of your land; and earth shall descend upon you from heaven, until He wears you away, and until He destroys you.
units.Deuteronomy 28:36: The Lord lead you, and your rulers whom you shall set over yourself, unto a nation which neither you nor your fathers have known; and there you shall serve other gods, wood and stone.
units.Deuteronomy 28:37: And there you shall become a riddle, and a parable, and a tale among all the nations whither the Lord shall lead you.
units.Lamentations 1:7: Jerusalem remembered the days of her humiliation and rejection, all her desired things from ancient days. When her people fell into the oppressor’s hands and no one helped her, her enemies saw her and laughed at her deportation.
units.Lamentations 1:8: Jerusalem has sinned grievously; therefore she has come into upheaval. All who glorified her humbled her, for they saw her shame. She too groaned and turned backward.
units.Lamentations 1:9: Her uncleanness is at her feet; she did not remember her last things. He brought her down exceedingly; there is no one to comfort her. See, Lord, my humiliation, for the enemy has grown great!
units.Exodus 20:12: Honour your father and your mother, that it may be well with you, and that your days may be long upon the good land which the Lord your God gives you.
units.Leviticus 19:30: You shall keep My Sabbaths and revere My holy things. I am the Lord.
units.Proverbs 1:10: Son, do not let ungodly men lead you astray; do not agree if they invite you, saying,
units.Proverbs 1:11: Come with us; share in bloodshed. Let us hide a righteous man in the earth unjustly;
units.Proverbs 1:12: let us swallow him alive like Hades and remove his memory from the earth.
units.Proverbs 1:13: Let us seize his costly property and fill our houses with spoils.
units.Proverbs 1:14: Cast your lot among us; let us all obtain a common purse, and let there be one moneybag for us.
units.Proverbs 1:15: Do not walk in the way with them; turn your foot away from their paths,
units.Proverbs 1:16: for their feet run toward evil, and they are quick to shed blood.
units.Proverbs 1:17: For nets are not unjustly stretched out for winged creatures.
units.Proverbs 1:18: For those who share in murder store up evils for themselves, and the overthrow of lawless men is evil.
units.Proverbs 1:19: These are the ways of all who carry out lawless deeds, for through ungodliness they take away their own life.
units.Leviticus 18:6: No person shall approach any relative of his flesh to uncover nakedness. I am the Lord.
units.Leviticus 18:7: You shall not uncover your father’s nakedness or your mother’s nakedness. She is your mother; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
units.Leviticus 18:8: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife; it is your father’s nakedness.
units.Leviticus 18:9: The nakedness of your sister, from your father or from your mother, born at home or born outside: you shall not uncover her nakedness.
units.Leviticus 18:10: The nakedness of your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter, you shall not uncover their nakedness, for it is your nakedness.
units.Leviticus 18:11: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter. She is your sister by the same father; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
units.Leviticus 18:12: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister; she is your father’s close relative.
units.Leviticus 18:13: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister; she is your mother’s close relative.
units.Leviticus 18:14: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother, and you shall not go in to his wife. She is your relative.
units.Leviticus 18:15: You shall not uncover your daughter-in-law’s nakedness. She is your son’s wife; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
units.Deuteronomy 27:24: Cursed is he who strikes his neighbour treacherously. And all the people shall say: So be it.
units.Deuteronomy 27:25: Cursed is he who takes a bribe to slay an innocent life. And all the people shall say: So be it.
units.Deuteronomy 27:26: Cursed is every man who does not continue in all the words of this law, to do them. And all the people shall say: So be it.
units.Isaiah 1:21: How the faithful city Zion has become a prostitute, full of judgment, in which righteousness lay at rest, but now murderers!
units.Isaiah 1:22: Your silver is unapproved; your retailers mix the wine with water.
units.Isaiah 1:23: Your rulers disobey, partners of thieves, loving gifts and pursuing repayment, not judging for orphans and not attending to widows’ judgment.
units.Jeremiah 6:27: I have made you a tester among tested peoples, and you will know Me when I test their way.
units.Jeremiah 6:28: All are unheeding, walking crookedly, bronze and iron; all are corrupted.
units.Jeremiah 6:29: The bellows failed from the fire; the lead failed. In vain the silversmith works silver; their wickedness was not melted away.
units.Jeremiah 6:30: Call them rejected silver, because the Lord rejected them.
units.Proverbs 17:3: As silver and gold are tested in a furnace, so hearts are chosen before the Lord.
units.Psalms 17:8: And the earth was shaken and began to tremble; the foundations of the mountains were troubled and shaken because God was angry with them.
units.Psalms 17:9: Smoke rose in His anger, and fire from His face set things ablaze; coals were kindled from Him.
units.Psalms 17:10: And He bent heaven and came down, and gloom was beneath His feet.
units.Psalms 17:11: And He mounted cherubim and flew; He flew on the wings of winds.
units.Psalms 17:12: And He made darkness His hiding place; His tent was around Him, dark water in clouds of the air.
units.Psalms 17:13: From the far-shining radiance before Him, the clouds passed— hail and coals of fire.
units.Psalms 17:14: And the Lord thundered from heaven, and the Most High gave His voice.
units.Psalms 17:15: And He sent out arrows and scattered them; He multiplied lightning flashes and threw them into turmoil.
units.Psalms 17:16: And the springs of the waters appeared, and the foundations of the inhabited world were uncovered at Thy rebuke, Lord, at the blast of the spirit of Thine anger.
units.Psalms 65:8: Bless our God, nations, and cause the sound of His praise to be heard,
units.Psalms 65:9: He who set my soul in life and did not give my feet over to shaking.
units.Psalms 65:10: For Thou didst test us, God; Thou didst try us by fire as silver is tried by fire.
units.Psalms 65:11: Thou broughtest us into the trap; Thou didst place afflictions upon our back.
units.Psalms 65:12: Thou madest human beings mount our heads; we passed through fire and water, and Thou broughtest us out to refreshment.
units.Zephaniah 3:1: O conspicuous and redeemed city, the dove-city!
units.Zephaniah 3:2: She did not heed a voice or accept discipline; she did not trust the Lord or approach her God.
units.Zephaniah 3:3: Her rulers within her are like roaring lions; her judges are like Arabian wolves, leaving nothing for morning.
units.Zephaniah 3:4: Her prophets are bearers of a spirit, contemptuous men; her priests profane holy things and act impiously toward law.
units.Zephaniah 3:5: But the Lord is righteous within her and will certainly do no injustice. Morning by morning He will bring His judgment to light; He was not hidden and knew no injustice in exaction, nor injustice in strife.
units.Leviticus 10:8: And the Lord spoke unto Aaron, saying:
units.Leviticus 10:9: You shall drink no wine or strong drink, you and your sons with you, when you enter the Tent of Testimony, or when you approach the altar, so that you do not die: an everlasting statute throughout your generations,
units.Leviticus 10:10: to distinguish between the holy and the profane, and between the unclean and the clean.
units.Leviticus 10:11: And you shall instruct the sons of Israel in all the statutes which the Lord spoke unto them by the hand of Moses.
units.Ezekiel 44:15: The Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, who kept the duties of My holy places when the house of Israel strayed from Me, will approach Me to minister to Me. They will stand before Me to offer sacrifice, fat, and blood to Me, says the Lord God.
units.Ezekiel 44:16: They will enter My holy places and approach My table to minister to Me, and they will keep My duties.
units.Ezekiel 44:17: When they enter the gates of the inner court, they will put on linen robes. They will not wear woolen things when they minister from the gate of the inner court.
units.Ezekiel 44:18: They will have linen turbans on their heads and linen trousers on their hips, and they will not bind their clothing tightly.
units.Ezekiel 44:19: When they go out to the outer court, to the people, they will take off the robes in which they minister, place them in the recessed chambers of the holy places, and put on other robes. They will certainly not sanctify the people with their robes.
units.Ezekiel 44:20: They will not shave their heads or strip away their hair; they will certainly cover their heads.
units.Ezekiel 44:21: No priest will drink wine when they enter the inner court.
units.Ezekiel 44:22: They will not take a widow or a woman who has been sent away as a wife, but a virgin of Israel’s offspring; if she is a priest’s widow, they may take her.
units.Ezekiel 44:23: They will teach My people the difference between holy and profane, and make known to them the difference between unclean and clean.
units.Ezekiel 44:24: In a case involving blood they will stand to decide. They will uphold My judgments and judge My decisions; they will keep My ordinances and My commands at all My festivals, and sanctify My Sabbaths.
units.Zechariah 7:8: The word of the Lord came to Zechariah, saying:
units.Zechariah 7:9: “Thus says the Lord Almighty: Render righteous judgment; show mercy and compassion, each to his brother.
units.Zechariah 7:10: Do not oppress widow, orphan, newcomer or poor person, and let no one harbor resentment for his brother’s wrong in your hearts.”
units.Zechariah 7:11: But they refused to pay attention, turned a senseless back and made their ears heavy so as not to listen,
units.Zechariah 7:12: and made their heart disobedient, so as not to listen to My law and the words the Lord Almighty sent by His Spirit through the former prophets. Great anger came from the Lord Almighty.
units.Zechariah 7:13: It will be as He spoke and they did not listen to Him: so they will cry out, and I will certainly not listen, says the Lord Almighty.
units.Zechariah 7:14: I will cast them out among all the nations they did not know, and the land behind them will be obliterated, without anyone passing through or returning. They made a choice land a desolation.
units.Jeremiah 5:1: Run through Jerusalem’s streets and see and learn, and search her squares: if you find a man, if there is one doing justice and seeking faithfulness, then I will be merciful to them, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 5:2: They say, ‘The Lord lives’; do they not therefore swear on falsehoods?
units.Jeremiah 5:3: Lord, Thine eyes are toward faithfulness. Thou didst scourge them, and they did not suffer; Thou broughtest them to an end, and they would not accept instruction. They hardened their faces beyond rock and would not return.
units.Jeremiah 5:4: And I said: Perhaps they are poor, because they had no ability, because they did not know the Lord’s way and God’s judgment.
units.Jeremiah 5:5: I will go to the prosperous and speak to them, for they recognized the Lord’s way and God’s judgment. And behold, with one accord they broke the yoke and tore the bonds.
units.Ezekiel 9:8: As they struck, I fall upon my face and cried aloud and said, “Alas, Lord! Art Thou obliterating the survivors of Israel as Thou pourest out Thy wrath upon Jerusalem?”
units.Ezekiel 9:9: He said to me, “The injustice of the house of Israel and Judah has grown very, very great, because the land is full of many peoples, and the city full of injustice and uncleanness. For they said, ‘The Lord has abandoned the land; the Lord does not look upon it.’
units.Ezekiel 9:10: My eye will not spare, nor will I have mercy. I have brought their ways upon their heads.”
units.Ezekiel 9:11: And behold, the man wearing the full-length robe, with the belt fastened at his waist, answered, saying, “I have done as Thou didst command me.”
units.Ezekiel 21:13: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 21:14: “Son of man, prophesy and say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Say: Sword, sword, be sharpened and enraged,
units.Ezekiel 21:15: so that you may slaughter victims. Be sharpened to become gleaming. Ready for paralysis, slaughter! Disdain; thrust away every tree.
units.Ezekiel 21:16: He gave it ready for his hand to grasp. The sword has been sharpened; it is ready to be put into the hand of one who pierces.
units.Ezekiel 21:17: Cry aloud and wail, son of man, for it has come among My people, among all Israel’s leaders. They will sojourn upon a sword; it has come among My people. Therefore strike upon your hand.
units.Ezekiel 21:18: For it has been justified. And what if even a tribe was rejected? It will not be, says the Lord, the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 21:19: And you, son of man, prophesy and strike hand upon hand, and double the sword. The third sword of the wounded is the great sword of the wounded, and it will terrify them,
units.Ezekiel 21:20: so that the heart is shattered and the weak multiply at every gate of theirs. They have been handed over as victims of a sword. It has been well prepared for slaughter, well prepared for gleaming.
units.Ezekiel 23:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 23:2: “Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother,
units.Ezekiel 23:3: and they prostituted themselves in Egypt in their youth. There their breasts fell; there they were deflowered.
units.Ezekiel 23:4: Their names were Oholah the elder and Oholibah her sister. They became Mine and bore sons and daughters. Their names: Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem is Oholibah.
units.Ezekiel 23:5: Oholah prostituted herself away from Me and set her desire upon her lovers, the Assyrians approaching her,
units.Ezekiel 23:6: clothed in blue-purple, leaders and generals; all choice young men, horsemen riding horses.
units.Ezekiel 23:7: She bestowed her prostitution upon them, all choice sons of Assyrians; and with all upon whom she set her desire, in all her reflections she was defiled.
units.Ezekiel 23:8: She did not abandon her prostitution from Egypt, for they lay with her in her youth; they deflowered her and poured their prostitution upon her.
units.Ezekiel 23:9: Therefore I handed her into her lovers’ hands, into the hands of Assyrians’ sons, upon whom she had set her desire.
units.Ezekiel 23:10: They uncovered her shame, took her sons and daughters, and killed her with the sword. She became a subject of talk among women, and they inflicted punishments upon her, upon the daughters.
units.Ezekiel 23:11: Her sister Oholibah saw this and corrupted her desire beyond hers, and her prostitution beyond her sister’s prostitution.
units.Ezekiel 23:12: She set her desire upon Assyrians’ sons, leaders and generals near her, clothed in finely bordered garments, horsemen riding horses; all choice young men.
units.Ezekiel 23:13: I saw that she was defiled; one way for the two.
units.Ezekiel 23:14: She added to her prostitution and saw men depicted upon the wall, images of Chaldeans drawn with a stylus,
units.Ezekiel 23:15: girded with embroidered work at their waists, with dyed tiaras upon their heads, all with a threefold appearance, the likeness of Chaldeans’ sons from their native land.
units.Ezekiel 23:16: She set her desire upon them at the sight of her eyes and sent messengers to them in the Chaldeans’ land.
units.Ezekiel 23:17: Babylon’s sons came to her, to a bed of lodgers, and defiled her in her prostitution. She was defiled by them, and her soul withdrew from them.
units.Ezekiel 23:18: She uncovered her prostitution and uncovered her shame. My soul withdrew from her, as My soul had withdrawn from her sister.
units.Ezekiel 23:19: You multiplied your prostitution to recall the days of your youth, in which you prostituted yourself in Egypt,
units.Ezekiel 23:20: and you set your desire upon the Chaldeans, whose flesh was like donkeys’ and whose genitals were horses’ genitals.
units.Ezekiel 23:21: You revisited the lawlessness of your youth, what you did in Egypt at your lodging, where your youthful breasts were.
units.Ezekiel 23:22: Therefore, Oholibah, thus says the Lord: Behold, I am rousing your lovers against you, those from whom your soul withdrew. I will bring them against you all around:
units.Ezekiel 23:23: Babylon’s sons and all the Chaldeans, Phakoud, Soue and Koue, and all Assyrians’ sons with them, choice young men, all leaders and generals, threefold men and renowned men riding horses.
units.Ezekiel 23:24: All will come against you from the north: chariots and wheels with a multitude of peoples, large shields and small shields; they will set a guard against you all around. I will set judgment before them, and they will punish you by their judgments.
units.Ezekiel 23:25: I will set My jealousy within you, and they will deal with you in fierce anger. They will remove your nose and ears and strike down your remaining people with the sword. They will take your sons and daughters, and fire will consume your remaining people.
units.Ezekiel 23:26: They will strip you of your clothing and take the objects of your boasting.
units.Ezekiel 23:27: I will turn your impieties away from you and your prostitution from Egypt’s land. You certainly will not lift your eyes toward them, and you certainly will no longer remember Egypt.
units.Ezekiel 23:28: For thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am handing you into the hands of those you hate, those from whom your soul withdrew.
units.Ezekiel 23:29: They will deal with you in hatred and take all the fruit of your pain and toil. You will be naked and exposed to shame, and the shame of your prostitution and your impiety will be uncovered. Your prostitution

units.Ezekiel 24:6: Therefore thus says the Lord: O city of bloodshed! A cauldron with rust in it, whose rust has not come out of her! He brought it out limb by limb; no lot fell upon her.

units.Ezekiel 24:13: because you were being defiled. And what if you are not cleansed any more until I fill up My wrath?
units.Ezekiel 24:14: I, the Lord, have spoken, and it will come, and I will act. I will not draw back, nor will I show mercy. units.Job 16:18: Earth, do not cover the blood of my flesh, and let there be no place for my cry!
units.Job 16:19: Even now, behold, my witness is in the heavens, and the one who knows with me is in the highest places.
units.Job 16:20: May my supplication reach the Lord, and may my eye drip tears before Him.
units.Job 16:21: May there be a hearing for a man before the Lord, and may a son of man plead for his neighbor.
units.Job 16:22: The numbered years have come, and I will travel a way on which I will not return.

units.Jeremiah 1:13: The Lord’s word came to me a second time, saying, What do you see? I said, A cauldron heated from beneath, its face away from the north.
units.Jeremiah 1:14: The Lord said to me, From the north calamities will be kindled upon all who inhabit the land.
units.Jeremiah 1:15: Because behold, I am summoning all the kingdoms from the north of the land, says the Lord. They will come and each set his throne at the forecourts of Jerusalem’s gates, against all her surrounding walls and against all Judah’s cities.
units.Jeremiah 1:16: I will speak to them with judgment concerning all their evil, because they abandoned Me, sacrificed to foreign gods and bowed down to the works of their hands.
units.Malachi 3:1: “Look, I am sending out My messenger, and he will look to a way before My face. Suddenly the Lord whom you seek will come to His own sanctuary, and the messenger of the covenant whom you desire. Look, he is coming,” says the Lord Almighty.
units.Malachi 3:2: And who will endure the day of his entrance? Or who will stand at his appearance? For he enters like a smelting fire and like launderers’ herb.
units.Malachi 3:3: He will sit, smelting and purifying as with silver and gold. He will cleanse the sons of Levi and melt them like gold and silver, and they will be those who bring a sacrifice to the Lord in righteousness.
units.Malachi 3:4: And the sacrifice of Judah and Jerusalem will please the Lord, as in the days of old and as in the former years.
units.Isaiah 4:2: On that day God will shine out in counsel with glory upon the earth, to exalt and glorify what remains of Israel,
units.Isaiah 4:3: and those remaining in Zion and left in Jerusalem will be called holy, all those recorded for life in Jerusalem,
units.Isaiah 4:4: because the Lord will wash away the filth of Zion’s sons and daughters and thoroughly cleanse the blood from their midst, by a spirit of judgment and a spirit of burning.

units.Ezekiel 7:6: My eye will not spare, nor will I have mercy; I will bring your ways upon you, and your abominations will be in your midst. You will recognize that I am the Lord who strikes.
units.Ezekiel 7:7: Now the end is upon you. I Myself will send against you and exact retribution upon you in your ways; I will bring all your abominations upon you.

units.Isaiah 20:2: then the Lord spoke to Isaiah, saying, “Go, remove the sackcloth from your waist and untie the sandals on your feet.” He did so, going naked and without sandals.
units.Isaiah 20:3: The Lord said, “As Isaiah My servant has gone naked and without sandals for three years, there will be signs and wonders for the Egyptians and Ethiopians;
units.Isaiah 20:4: for thus the king of the Assyrians will lead Egypt’s and the Ethiopians’ captivity, young men and elders, naked and without sandals, exposed as Egypt’s shame.

units.Ezekiel 33:22: The Lord’s hand came upon me in the evening before he arrived, and He opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning. Once my mouth was opened, it was no longer restrained.

units.Jeremiah 2:32: Will a bride forget her adornment, or a virgin her breastband? Yet My people forgot Me for days beyond counting.
